cells.name: radial_front
cells.species: the noise-free radial front: a plain disc of ice, the baseline

cells.name: vein_bulge
cells.species: the front bulges along cold veins: an ADDITIVE, bounded bias

cells.name: vein_warp_fail
cells.species: BEFORE: a multiplicative vein warp smears the front into tendrils

cells.name: dendrite_fingers
cells.species: short crystal arms reach past the mean front (FrostFinger)

cells.name: band_early_out
cells.species: cost view: only the amber ring runs the vein and finger noise

cells.name: coverage_view
cells.species: the coverage debug view: three smoothsteps across the band

cells.name: age_view
cells.species: the age debug view: 0 at landing, 1 once the front is _AgeDistance past

cells.name: frost_surface
cells.species: the whole FrostShade model on a spreading zone

cells.name: chill_drain
cells.species: chill: the first band drains the colour ahead of the ice (left half: the band)

cells.name: sweat_wet
cells.species: sweat: the middle band darkens and wets the floor (left half: the band)

cells.name: hoar_dust
cells.species: hoar: the last band dusts the ridges white (left half: the band)

cells.name: coldfront_recolor
cells.species: all three bands together recolour the floor ahead of the crust

cells.name: barrier_feather
cells.species: the overlay barrier: hoar and sweat feather the front at alpha 0.7

cells.name: lead_band
cells.species: lead weight: the thin frosty edge (coverage below 0.33)

cells.name: mid_band
cells.species: mid weight: the band being frozen (0.33 to 0.66)

cells.name: full_band
cells.species: full weight: the overtaken crust, with all three weights as rings

cells.name: tri_lattice
cells.species: the tan30 skew turns a square grid into triangles: two per cell

cells.name: voronoi_crystals
cells.species: large crystals: level 0 is a jittered Voronoi F1 lattice

cells.name: lod_levels
cells.species: the three lattice levels side by side: 0 coarse, 1, 2 fine

cells.name: footprint_fade
cells.species: zoom in and out: each level fades once its triangles fall under ~3 px

cells.name: facet_normals
cells.species: the tilted micro-facet normal as a normal map

cells.name: sparkle_glint
cells.species: FrostSparkleGlint: a power-1400 lobe on each facet as the light moves

cells.name: key_twinkle
cells.species: FrostKeyGlint: a power-900 lobe on the fixed key, twinkling per facet

cells.name: gem_prism
cells.species: gem specular: three per-channel powers fringe a highlight like a prism

cells.name: fern_veins
cells.species: fern veins: ridged noise cubed keeps them thin and sharp

cells.name: edge_hug
cells.species: the crust hugs plate seams: hug (deep) and edge core (white)

cells.name: rind_albedo
cells.species: FrostRindEval albedo: deep to white by age, hug, core and fern

cells.name: rind_opacity
cells.species: rind opacity: thin on open plates, solid at seams and with age

cells.name: subsurface
cells.species: subsurface only: the sss palette scaled by the depth proxy

cells.name: inner_surface
cells.species: the fake inner surface: refract, bounce off a per-facet normal, read the sky

cells.name: sky_reflection
cells.species: FrostEnvColor: an ice lens reflects the fake sky gradient

cells.name: snow_drift
cells.species: dry snow banks against the seams and dusts the open plates with age

cells.name: melt_resist
cells.species: resist: 1 at the seed, 0 at the edge, so the edge melts first

cells.name: melt_breakup
cells.species: the ridged break-up that roughens the melt ring

cells.name: outside_in
cells.species: the crust retreats from the frozen edge inward, not from the seed

cells.name: wet_then_dry
cells.species: the melt stages as colour: ice, wet (deep), dry (bare)

cells.name: wet_sheen
cells.species: the wet sheen trails the retreat, dark and glossy, then dries

cells.name: hazard_heat
cells.species: three moving hazard sources carve the ice; their heat adds

cells.name: heat_falloff
cells.species: falloff below 1 clears a wide area (left); above 1 a small hole (right)

cells.name: freeze_melt_loop
cells.species: the full loop: grow, hold, melt outside-in, wet, dry, bare, again

cells.name: edge_vignette
cells.species: screen frost grows in from the edges; the centre stays clear

cells.name: proximity_ramp
cells.species: intensity follows the zone distance: the band breathes in and out

cells.name: radial_badge
cells.species: the badge mode: a tendriled disc from the centre, with frost flits

cells.name: tendril_warp
cells.species: the vignette domain warp: a coarse octave for fingers, a fine one for grit

cells.name: sparkle_sine
cells.species: AFTER: each facet pulses on a slow sine phase, so the glint fades in and out

cells.name: sparkle_strobe
cells.species: BEFORE: a fract(sin) hash of a moving value strobes every frame (hover)

cells.name: tri_coverage_fail
cells.species: BEFORE: coverage from coarse triangles steps the front in a grid

cells.name: fern_body
cells.species: the vignette body alone: fern veins and the hug-thickened front edge

cells.name: sprite_outline
cells.species: the outline from 8-direction alpha min and max: both sides of the edge

cells.name: desat_tint
cells.species: grey first, then blue (top); a direct lerp passes through purple (bottom)

cells.name: outline_pulse
cells.species: the cyan outline with an icy lip breathes on a slow shallow pulse

cells.name: frozen_sprite
cells.species: the whole FrostSprite: fill fades to thin blue ice, outline stays crisp

cells.name: decal_sheen
cells.species: the decal path: a thin veil plus crystal glints keep the marking legible

cells.name: decal_vs_crust
cells.species: left: the default crust hides the marking; right: the decal path

cells.name: footprint_sdf
cells.species: a zone footprint as a smooth union of soft ellipses (original)

cells.name: footprint_frost
cells.species: the ellipse footprint drives coverage, with fingers on its rim (original)
